title: NightWatch Execution Request
description: Unified executor request (C02/C03 → C09). Field list source: §5.7 unified request, verbatim field names (execution_id, run_id, executor, executor_version, scenario_ref, environment, timeout_seconds, repetitions, seed, credential_env_allowlist, artifact_policy). Idempotency key and deadline are mandatory per §22.5.4 ('Command、Execution、Issue Publish 都必须带幂等键和明确 Deadline').

scenario_ref.description: Reference to the compiled scenario asset (path or identifier).

timeout_seconds.description: Execution timeout budget in seconds (field name frozen by §5.7).

credential_env_allowlist.description: Whitelist of credential variable NAMES injected into the worker subprocess. Children never inherit full process.env (§13.1.1).

artifact_policy.description: Artifact capture policy, e.g. 'full-on-failure' (value vocabulary owned by executors; not frozen as an enum in v1).
